items.prompt: A film starts at 14:25 and lasts 2 hours 50 minutes. At what time does it finish? Use the 24-hour clock, like 09:05.
hints: Now add 50 minutes. Remember 60 minutes make an hour.

items.prompt: Bayu in Jakarta phones his friend Amara in London at 20:30 Jakarta time. In winter, London is 7 hours behind Jakarta. What time is it in London? Use the 24-hour clock.
hints: Behind means the clock shows an earlier time.

items.prompt: A train leaves at 09:48 and arrives at 13:15. How many minutes does the journey take?
hints: Count to the next whole hour first.
Then from 10:00 to 13:15 is 3 hours 15 minutes.
items.explanation: 12 min + 3 h 15 min = 3 h 27 min, which is 3 × 60 + 27 = 207 minutes.

items.prompt: True or false: A train that leaves at 09:50 and arrives at 12:20 takes 2 hours 30 minutes.
hints: Count on to the next hour.
items.explanation: 09:50 to 10:00 is 10 min. 10:00 to 12:00 is 2 h. 12:00 to 12:20 is 20 min. Total 2 h 30 min.

items.prompt: True or false: When it is 10:00 in WIB (UTC+7), it is 09:00 in WITA (UTC+8).
items.explanation: WITA is 1 hour ahead of WIB, so it is 11:00 in WITA.

items.prompt: In Indonesia, WIB is the time in Jakarta. WITA is 1 hour ahead of WIB. A plane leaves Jakarta at 07:30 WIB and the flight to Makassar takes 2 hours 40 minutes.
hints: Add 1 hour to the Jakarta time.
items.explanation: 2 h 40 min = 160 min. 07:30 + 2 h 40 min = 10:10 WIB. WITA is 1 hour ahead, so the time in Makassar is 11:10.

parts.prompt: How many minutes is the flight?
